verdict.oneLine: The ATTRIBUTION lane is a real repair, measured and reproduced end to end: every artifact-side forgery I could build from the freeze's own enumeration is caught, v4 sees none of them, and the corpus cost is zero. It ships with one undisclosed escape of exactly the class it exists to close - wrapping the forged scalar in a one-element JSON array defeats the instrument's own advertised aliased-key vector - and one published residual measurement that does not reproduce on the bytes under review.
verdict.scoringBasis: FINDING-SET DELTA, not exit code. Stated explicitly because on this tree EVERY vector I ran exits 1, including the clean baseline: two pre-existing PD2-SCAN-CONFLICT findings are live regardless. An exit-code-based score would have reported 'no change' for all eleven catches. Exiting 1 is not a fault of this instrument.
verdict.whyNotAccept: B-PD5-01 is an escape, not a boundary. The instrument publishes an ALIASED signedOffBy/approvedOn vector as a must-fail case and catches it; the identical forgery with each scalar wrapped in a one-element array produces ZERO findings and ZERO observations. That is the v4 blocker's own shape - the forgery buys silence - reappearing one level down, in a JSON shape this corpus uses routinely. It is repairable in a successor by a two-line change and it is disclosed nowhere in the 36 residuals.
verdict.whyNotReject: Nothing measured here is false about the catch. The twelve-vector claim reproduces (as eleven distinct documents, see the arithmetic note), the zero-false-positive acceptance test reproduces on all nine legitimate-occurrence files and across 437 scanned artifacts, the derivation is genuinely shape-based against LIVE packet bytes and not only the synthetic fixture, the no-regression property is byte-identical, and the disclosure apparatus (36 residuals, 21 gated, a selftest that fails on a dangling gate label) works as described. The blockers are a missed shape and a stale number, not a defective lane.

adjudicationOfTheFourDisclosedResiduals.authorsPosition: accepted BY CONSTRUCTION, since the honest majority of the corpus does exactly this
adjudicationOfTheFourDisclosedResiduals.myAdjudication: REAL BOUNDARY. Correctly graded and correctly gated.
adjudicationOfTheFourDisclosedResiduals.evidence: Measured on the live corpus: 200 decided-frame clauses are examined and only 17 coordinates are supplied at all. Demanding attribution from every artifact that asserts closure would convert roughly 183 sites into findings against artifacts that are doing nothing wrong. The instrument's own must-pass case set includes this shape and it is executed as an expected escape, so the disclosure cannot go stale.
adjudicationOfTheFourDisclosedResiduals.residualRiskToRecord: The property enforced is agreement-or-silence. Silence is therefore always available to a forger who is content to assert closure without attributing it. That is a genuinely open direction, but closing it is a corpus-authoring decision (require attribution) and not an instrument decision.

adjudicationOfTheFourDisclosedResiduals.residual: A2 - the COHERENT lie (restate the real authority and date, invert the substance)
adjudicationOfTheFourDisclosedResiduals.authorsPosition: belongs to the posture lane, which reads the packet and not artifacts
adjudicationOfTheFourDisclosedResiduals.myAdjudication: REAL BOUNDARY FOR THIS LANE - but it exposes a SYSTEM-level gap that no lane owns, and the freeze should say so.
adjudicationOfTheFourDisclosedResiduals.evidence: Verified: an artifact asserting 'DECIDED 2026-08-05 by sfbreen: ephemeral by default, implicit durable retention NO' produces zero attribution findings, correctly, because both coordinates agree. Separately verified: inverting the posture inside the PACKET produces zero findings from v4's packet lane too (the authority and date substitutions there DO fire, at 3 and 4 findings respectively). So neither lane binds the substance of the decision as restated by an artifact.
adjudicationOfTheFourDisclosedResiduals.consequence: The corpus has a lane that compares an artifact's STATE to the packet, a lane that compares an artifact's ATTRIBUTION to the packet, and NO lane that compares an artifact's SUBSTANCE to the packet. 7.8's bound - 'a string leaf whose VALUE is false while its PATH and TYPE are unchanged' - is the exact shape, and it is not repealed. Recording this as a system observation, not as a defect of v5: narrowing A2 here would require reading the decision body, which is a different instrument.

adjudicationOfTheFourDisclosedResiduals.residual: A3 - the citation excuse, inherited not introduced
adjudicationOfTheFourDisclosedResiduals.authorsPosition: narrowing it here would make two lanes disagree about what an assertion is
adjudicationOfTheFourDisclosedResiduals.myAdjudication: REPAIRABLE, AND CORRECTLY DEFERRED. The author's reasoning is right and the deferral is the right call at this level.
adjudicationOfTheFourDisclosedResiduals.evidence: Verified: appending '.json#detail' to the forged clause produces zero findings, and the subject demonstrates this deliberately in its own false-positive matrix rather than hiding it. The predicate is v1.FILE_REFERENCE_RE / PLACEHOLDER_RE / POINTER_RE, called not copied, and it governs the state lane beside it.
adjudicationOfTheFourDisclosedResiduals.cost: one appended pointer buys silence from BOTH lanes at once. That is the sharpest available single-token evasion in the instrument and it is disclosed in full.
adjudicationOfTheFourDisclosedResiduals.recommendation: the repair belongs at the shared predicate in the pinned closure - a successor to the first-generation assertion vocabulary that distinguishes 'this clause CITES a document' from 'this clause carries a pointer AND makes its own closure assertion'. Doing it in v5 alone would be worse than the escape, exactly as the author says.

adjudicationOfTheFourDisclosedResiduals.residual: A6 - JSON-only, the exclusion protecting section 4.4's own record
adjudicationOfTheFourDisclosedResiduals.authorsPosition: that is what keeps the corpus's own forensic record from being reported as the incident, and it is equally what an author could exploit
adjudicationOfTheFourDisclosedResiduals.myAdjudication: REAL BOUNDARY AT THE LANE, LARGEST HOLE IN THE INSTRUMENT, AND HONESTLY STATED BY THE SUBJECT - understated by freeze 4.4's head block.
adjudicationOfTheFourDisclosedResiduals.evidence: Measured: 6 of the 9 files carrying the fabricated attribution are outside the scanned population by construction. Five of those six are INSTRUMENTS - live .py files that execute. An author who wanted to plant a fabricated attribution where this instrument cannot see it needs only to choose a .py or .md. The instrument states this exactly and, better, MEASURES the population rather than asserting it: --selftest checks that the scanned suffix set is ['.json'], which I confirmed.
adjudicationOfTheFourDisclosedResiduals.whyItIsStillTheRightChoiceHere: The lane inherits its scanner from the pinned closure and 7.2/7.6 forbid editing it. Widening the glob in a successor would immediately fire on freeze 4.4 itself and on five instruments' fixtures, which is the outcome that makes a lane unusable. Widening it correctly requires the assertion vocabulary to understand .py string literals and .md quotation, which is a different instrument.
adjudicationOfTheFourDisclosedResiduals.recordCorrectionOwed: freeze 4.4's 'Measured: 0 findings and 0 observations on all nine' should carry the 6/3 partition, because as written it credits judgement with a result mostly produced by scope.

recordCorrectionsOwedToFREEZE_4_4_HEAD_B.text: 'the freeze's own forensic record of the incident (twice), the claim register's struck entry (3x), two review artifacts, and FOUR instruments' test fixtures' - that enumeration sums to EIGHT files against a headline of NINE. blockingFindings.title: A structured attribution wrapped in a JSON array escapes the lane entirely, defeating the instrument's own published aliased-key vector
blockingFindings.measured: {'CD-RT-5': {'status':'DECIDED','signedOffBy':['the coordinator'],'approvedOn':['2026-07-31']}} in a live artifact produces ZERO findings and ZERO observations. The identical document with the two values as scalars produces two findings and is shipped as must-fail case 11 of 12.
blockingFindings.mechanism: decision_subtree_leaves() yields an empty key for list elements; attribution_failures() guards the structured comparison with `if key and not why:`. Demonstrated directly against both shapes.
blockingFindings.alsoAffects: decidedBy/decidedOn in arrays; decidedOn as a JSON int; decidedBy as an object whose member key is not authority-shaped. The subject's hostile_shapes already contains 'an authority-shaped key whose value is an object' - it is graded there for NOT CRASHING and never for CATCHING, which is 7.8's recorded failure mode ('graded on whether assertions fire when content is REMOVED, never on whether they fire when content is FALSE') in its narrowest form.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: It is the v4 blocker's own shape - the forgery buys silence - reappearing inside the lane written to close it, in a JSON shape this corpus uses constantly, undisclosed in 36 residuals, and reachable by a one-character edit to a vector the instrument advertises catching.
blockingFindings.notADisagreementWithADisclosedResidual: A1, A2, A3, A4, A6, A7, A8, A9 and A10 were each checked against this vector and none covers it.
blockingFindings.repair: a successor. Either propagate the parent key through list traversal, or drive the structured comparison off leaf shape rather than key presence as the date limb already does. Add a must-fail case that wraps every structured must-fail vector in a one-element array.

blockingFindings.title: Residual A7 publishes a measurement that does not reproduce, and it is the one new residual left ungated
blockingFindings.claimed: 'Measured on this corpus: without the positional rule four live artifacts are false positives; with it, zero are, and the inverted construction occurs nowhere.'
blockingFindings.measured: Across the whole 437-artifact corpus, 32 decided-frame clauses reach by_phrases, they contain 5 `by X` matches in total, and the positional threshold drops ZERO of them. Removing the rule entirely changes the run by 0 live findings, 0 observations and 0 authority claims. A live control proves the patch works (an inverted construction goes 0 -> 2 AUTHORITY findings without the rule).
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: 7.2.2: a recorded measurement gets a hard comparison, and 'a figure a reader cannot recompute is prose wearing a measurement's clothes'. The instrument applies 7.8's sixth design move to six of its ten new residuals; A7 is one of the four it does not, and A7 is the one that drifted. The second half of the claim ('with it, zero are') reproduces and is not in dispute.
blockingFindings.fairness: the figure may have been true when measured against a different tree state; I cannot reconstruct that state and neither can a signer, which is the point.
blockingFindings.repair: a successor should either gate A7 by an executed case that recomputes the drop count from the live corpus and fails if the published figure disagrees in either direction, or withdraw the four-artifact figure in place and state only the qualitative rule.

nonBlockingObservations.text: PROPOSED-S5: the hard-coded seven-entry EXPECTED_CHOICES set means the section 3.1 Phase-1A insertion trips PD-1/PD2-1 regardless of attribution. 7.10's defect applied to a decision SET. Inherited, not introduced, disclosed nowhere in 36 residuals. This is the larger half of the PD4-N1 cost and it must not be understated at signature.

The BY_PHRASE_RE four-token bound is documented in a code comment and in no residual. With five or more filler words the finding still fires but names the wrong claimed authority ('delegated delegated delegated delegated'). A comma immediately after 'by' escapes outright.

Moving BOTH coordinates out of the closure predicate's clause unit escapes ('CD-RT-5 is DECIDED. Authority: product owner. Date: 2026-07-31.'). Moving only one is still caught. A7 names the inverted construction and not the lexical or segmentation halves.

Precision of the finding TEXT is uneven where the catch is sound. The register alias-key vector emits three findings for one mutation with phrases like 'the product owner for'; a live observation on retention-tiers.v5.json reports the asserted authority as 'the CD-RT-5'. No false live finding results, but a reader repairing from the message would be misled about what was asserted.

Three docstring sentences overstate the derivation's literal-freedom (see C5). The property holds of every predicate; the sentences quantify over the whole file, which carries the packet's real date, the fabricated date and the fabricated authority as fixture constants.

An unreadable scanned artifact is named and counted but does not gate the exit code; on an otherwise green tree the run exits 0 with one artifact unexamined. Inherited (S3), correctly visible in the census, worth a reader's attention.

A4's token-intersection residual is accurately stated but its sharpest sub-case is unnamed: a HYPHENATED extension of the recorded name ('by sfbreen-deputy') reads as agreement, because _role_verdict tokenises it to include the real name.
The 'stable across PYTHONHASHSEED' phrasing names a mechanism -I disables. The underlying order-independence is real and I verified it under six genuinely randomized seeds; only the wording is wrong.

whatIDidNotCheck: I did not independently recompute the sha256 of v3, v2 or v1. I verified the chain executes, that it refuses at exit 3 on a two-byte change to v4, that v4's live digest equals the literal the subject pins, and that the subject's derived permitted-import set closes at five files. The three deeper digests are taken on the chain's own verification, not on mine.

I did not audit the 26 INHERITED residuals for truth. I verified only that all 26 are carried, that tags are unique, that the 21/15 split is arithmetic from len(), and that a dangling gate label fails the suite. Whether R1-R5, D1-D7, S1-S4 and V1-V10 accurately describe the predecessors' behaviour is outside this review; v4's own reviewer found its predecessor's limits mis-stated in both directions, so this is a real uncovered surface.

I did not re-derive the predecessors' own lanes. The no-regression result (all predecessor must-fail, must-pass and expected-escape cases unchanged) is the subject's own selftest measurement; I confirmed it runs and passes but did not re-drive those case corpora with an independent driver.
I did not test duplicate JSON keys (residual A10/D7/V9). The parser keeps the last and I did not construct an artifact exercising it.

I did not attempt module-shadowing beyond confirming the invocation guard's exit-2 behaviour on both channels. I did not write a stdlib-named file beside the instrument and measure the un-isolated failure the docstring describes.

I did not verify the CONTENT of product-dispositions.v1.json or claim-register.v1.json against the freeze. I treated the packet as the instrument treats it - as the authority - and only mutated copies of it.
I ran on exactly one interpreter, CPython 3.14.6 on darwin. The verdict is environment-conditional to that (7.2).
I did not review IMPLEMENTER-BLUEPRINT.md, and I read only the freeze sections the dispatch named plus section 4.4's body.
I did not assess whether the 5 historical observations on retention-tiers.v5.json are semantically well-formed beyond noting one degenerate phrase extraction (OBS-4).
I did not measure runtime or memory under adversarial input beyond the subject's own 19 hostile shapes, which I confirmed produce no traceback.
I did not attempt to construct a forged REJECTING REVIEW to defeat standing (residual R4, inherited unchanged), nor a forged review record (R1/R2).

statedForASigner: the bytes are the reviewed bytes and predecessor drift stops the run at exit 3;
no artifact in the 437-file JSON population that has standing today asserts a product decision state, or an authority, or a date, that the binding packet does not carry;
conflicting attributions that survive in artifacts with no standing are printed in full and are never dropped, at any exit code;
the two coordinates it compares were re-derived from the live packet on this run, not transcribed.
itDoesNotMean: that no artifact asserts a fabricated attribution - a .py or .md is outside the lane by construction (A6), and 6 of the 9 files carrying the fabricated string live there;
that no LIVE JSON artifact asserts one - an attribution wrapped in a JSON array is not compared at all (B-PD5-01);
that the decision's SUBSTANCE agrees with the packet - no lane in this corpus compares that (A2);
that a conflict reported as an observation is harmless - it means an unreviewed successor exists, and 7.9's question applies: which successor demoted it, and has anything reviewed it?

conditionsToClear: A successor instrument that (a) compares authority-shaped and date-valued leaves inside JSON arrays, with a must-fail case wrapping every existing structured vector in a one-element array; and (b) either gates residual A7 on a recomputed corpus measurement or withdraws its four-artifact figure in place.
Freeze 4.4's head block corrected on REC-1, REC-2 and REC-3.
PROPOSED-S5 (the EXPECTED_CHOICES set pin) named as a residual somewhere a signer will read it, because the section 3.1 insertion trips it and nothing in this lineage says so.

It is therefore a TENTH legitimate-occurrence document, created live, and the lane is silent on it - an unplanned extra data point for the acceptance test in C4, taken on bytes the author never saw.
thisReviewArtifactsOwnEffectOnTheINSTRUM.self_measurement_caveat: This figure was computed BEFORE this paragraph was written into the file, so by 7.2.2's own rule it describes a document that no longer exists. It is published as an observation about an earlier byte state and not as a measured fact about these bytes. The only honest census is one re-walked after the write, and I have deliberately not published a leaf count or an occurrence count for this artifact for that reason.

closingNote: The instrument does the thing it was written to do, and it does it by derivation rather than by list, which is the harder and correct choice. Its acceptance test - not firing on the corpus's own forensic record of the forgery it hunts - is the part I expected to fail and it does not. Both blockers are of the same family as the one it closed: a shape the author had in hand and graded on the wrong axis, and a number nothing re-runs. Neither is a reason to distrust the lane; both are reasons not to sign it as final.
